{ "rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when price is below 10-day moving average to correct lagging mean-reversion bias",
    "Increase forecast magnitude when sentiment diverges from price movement to align with sentiment-driven momentum",
    "Compress forecast range when price volatility (std dev) drops 30%+ from peak to capture mean-reversion tightening",
    "Scale forecast distance from mean by sentiment alignment factor so bullish/filled sentiment over-projects",
    "Apply stronger correction when forecast deviation from history exceeds 24-hour range preventing overshoot",
    "Pull near-term forecasts toward today's price while extending tail divergence for horizon-dependent lag correction",
    "Detect and suppress forecast reversal when 3+ day price trend conflicts with forecast direction"
] }
